summary: Restore local-trim backups on the designated floor-28 rollback target (#6609).

rules.detail: No checkpoint retention or agreement rule change.

compatibility.detail: backup restore accepts an archive whose checkpoint has no matching certificate, including a local-trim cut. It checks the manifest shape and records the tombstones as the member's own. A certificate matching both cut and drop digest keeps the verified path unchanged. No wire change.

downtime.detail: No new interruption for running members; the change is in offline backup restore.

manual.detail: No manual step for running members.

recovery.detail: Designated rollback target for members with [trim] local = true across floor 28 (#6609). Local regression tests cover restore without a certificate and with a same-cut certificate for a different drop, preserving inventory and tombstones.
